source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Dismissing the client's anxiety as largely unwarranted, given their current position further down the liver transplant waiting list","B":"Acknowledging the uncertainty and emotional challenges of waitlist time, providing information and support resources, and connecting the client with peer support if desired","C":"Assuming that every client experiences essentially identical emotions while waiting on the transplant list for a matching donor organ to eventually become available","D":"Avoiding any discussion of the waitlist process altogether when interacting with the client during their regularly scheduled clinic visits"}}
source_row.rationale: Appropriate support for a client experiencing liver transplant waitlist anxiety includes acknowledging the genuine uncertainty and emotional challenges of this waiting period, providing clear information and support resources, and connecting the client with peer support if desired, individualized to their specific needs and concerns.
source_row.source_detail: Supporting Clients Through Liver Transplant Waitlist Anxiety
source_row.source_name: UNOS/AASLD — Psychosocial Support During Transplant Waitlist
